critique.evidence: Measured performance is hackathon-demo ready across all viewports: LCP is 1288 ms desktop, 1156 ms tablet, and 308 ms mobile; FCP is 52–72 ms; load completes in 129–154 ms; and TTFB is 1.5–7.5 ms. Layout is stable on desktop/mobile (CLS 0.001/0), though tablet CLS reaches 0.0478. No console, page, or request failures occurred, and no horizontal overflow was measured. Animation sampling reports zero long frames, but desktop averages 19.3 ms with a 33.4 ms worst frame. The main limitation is transfer weight: 1.31 MB total, including 1.15 MB of JavaScript, for 17 requests.
critique.fix: Code-split the 12-screen bundle so live-wire loads only its required JavaScript, targeting substantially below the current 1.15 MB. Reserve responsive element dimensions to eliminate the tablet CLS, and profile desktop rendering to keep typical frames within the 16.7 ms budget.
